title: Hi, I’m Basil.
text: Hi, I'm Basil. I said Tania couldn't easily turn Career Empire into something Curios teachers could make their own. Well, here we are!

title: Keep. Clear. Repurpose.
text: Her prompts were simple: keep the world, avatars, buildings and characters; remove the careers content; and leave the original untouched. The first explorable copy took about fifteen minutes.

title: Keep. Clear. Repurpose.
text: The teacher tools, branding, app rooms and testing came afterwards.

title: Walk in. Open an app.
text: Walk into the ArtQuest + Loopy Tunes centre. Walk up to either desktop PC and press E to open the app shown on its monitor. Archon Engine is in the Learning Hall. Return to Curios brings you back.

title: Make it your own.
text: Choose Teacher setup in the top bar. Change names, conversations and room links. Preview your ideas, then download the settings and give them to ICT to publish. Your curriculum gives this world its purpose.

title: Reuse. Repurpose. Recycle.
text: Reuse. Repurpose. Recycle. Curios: learning without limits. Apparently, you can teach an old NPC new tricks.
